notes_actionable.title: 3+-way ECMP (N>=3) is untested — only the 2-way diamond is covered
notes_actionable.evidence: core/ecmp_test.odin:75 testing.expectf(t, count == 2, "diamond source has 2 equal-cost next hops, got %d", count); :122 testing.expectf(t, ecmp_pick(7, 9, 0, 42, 2) < 2, "ecmp_pick n=2 in range [0,2)"); :131 bucket := [2]int{}; :133 bucket[int(ecmp_pick(0, 3, 0, pkt_id, 2))] += 1
notes_actionable.detail: Every ECMP test uses a 2-way diamond; ecmp_pick is never called with n>=3 and no 3+-way junction is built. Only n=1 and n=2 exercise the % n branch and multi-hop array packing.
notes_actionable.recommended_fix: Add a test with three equal-cost middle routers (count==3): assert all 3 hops pack into hops[] and ecmp_pick distributes across all 3 buckets.

notes_actionable.title: next_packet_id determinism has no direct assertion — relied on transitively by affinity + replay
notes_actionable.evidence: core/ecmp_test.odin:207 // run B: fresh run, same seed + same log + same demand; the SAME packet id; :208 // (next_packet_id is deterministic) -> the SAME first hop. Grep of core/*_test.odin for direct packet-id equality asserts (.id ==, packets[0].id, next_packet_id ==) returns none.
notes_actionable.detail: Flow affinity across two runs presumes identical packet ids, but no expect asserts it. Covered only transitively — a packet-id regression would surface as an affinity/replay failure, not a localized one.
notes_actionable.recommended_fix: Add an explicit expect that two same-seed runs assign identical ids, e.g. testing.expect(t, a.flow.packets[0].id == b.flow.packets[0].id), to localize the failure.

notes_actionable.title: routing_next_hop doc comment names routing_has_path as a caller, but this diff reroutes routing_has_path to routing_equal_cost_hops
notes_actionable.location: core/routing.odin | routing_next_hop doc comment + routing_has_path body
notes_actionable.evidence:
+// routing_next_hop — the FIRST (representative) equal-cost next hop at
+// `from_node` toward `dst_node`. A convenience over routing_equal_cost_hops for
+// callers that want a single deterministic hop (tests, routing_has_path). For a
 routing_has_path :: proc(r: ^Routing_Table, t: ^Topology, from_node, dst_node: u32) -> bool {
-	_, _, ok := routing_next_hop(r, t, from_node, dst_node)
-	return ok
+	_, count, ok := routing_equal_cost_hops(r, t, from_node, dst_node)
+	return ok && count > 0
 }
notes_actionable.detail: The new routing_next_hop comment names routing_has_path among its callers, but the same diff rewrites routing_has_path to call routing_equal_cost_hops directly. The caller list is stale/misleading.
notes_actionable.recommended_fix: Drop 'routing_has_path' from the comment's caller list (only tests call routing_next_hop now), or restore routing_has_path to delegate through routing_next_hop.
